items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: And I happen to know quite a bit about Ben Webster as a person and as a human being

ctx.x: But did you slave away at your talent or were you able to take it in your stride and develop it as you went along

Well, I think my approach to music is like most people, in fact you mentioned Ben Webster. And I happen to know quite a bit about Ben Webster as a person and as a human being and as a fellow who as I said my father gave me some instructions in psychology and what not at an early age. That makes it easy for me to detect certain peculiarities in people. And I think that Ben Webster probably had the same struggle that all musicians have, but it affected him differently and how he carried his self in personal life,…
